sn22.81:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kosambiyaṃ viharati ghositārāme.
sn22.81:1.2: atha kho bhagavā pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā, pattacīvaramādāya kosambiyaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.
sn22.81:1.3: kosambiyaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto sāmaṃ senāsanaṃ saṃsāmetvā pattacīvaramādāya anāmantetvā upaṭṭhāke anapaloketvā bhikkhusaṅghaṃ eko adutiyo cārikaṃ pakkāmi.
sn22.81:2.1: atha kho aññataro bhikkhu acirapakkantassa bhagavato yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca:
sn22.81:2.2: “esā’vuso ānanda, bhagavā sāmaṃ senāsanaṃ saṃsāmetvā pattacīvaramādāya anāmantetvā upaṭṭhāke anapaloketvā bhikkhusaṅghaṃ eko adutiyo cārikaṃ pakkantoti.
sn22.81:2.3: yasmiṃ āvuso samaye bhagavā sāmaṃ senāsanaṃ saṃsāmetvā pattacīvaramādāya anāmantetvā upaṭṭhāke anapaloketvā bhikkhusaṅghaṃ eko adutiyo cārikaṃ pakkamati, ekova bhagavā tasmiṃ samaye viharitukāmo hoti.
sn22.81:2.4: na bhagavā tasmiṃ samaye kenaci anubandhitabbo hotīti.
sn22.81:3.1: atha kho bhagavā anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena pārileyyakaṃ tadavasari.
sn22.81:3.2: tatra sudaṃ bhagavā pārileyyake viharati bhaddasālamūle.
sn22.81:3.3: atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū yena āyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā ānandena saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu.
sn22.81:3.4: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavocuṃ:
sn22.81:3.5: “cirassutā kho no āvuso ānanda bhagavato sammukhā dhammīkathā
sn22.81:3.6: icchāma mayaṃ āvuso ānanda, bhagavato sammukhā dhammiṃ kathaṃ sotunti”.
sn22.81:4.1: atha kho āyasmā ānando tehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ yena pārileyyakaṃ bhaddasālamūlaṃ yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
sn22.81:4.2: ekamantaṃ nisinne kho te bhikkhū bhagavā dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi. samādapesi. samuttejesi. sampahaṃsesi.
sn22.81:4.3: tena kho pana samayena aññatarassa bhikkhuno evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
sn22.81:4.4: “kathaṃ nu kho jānato kathaṃ passato anantarā āsavānaṃ khayo hotī”ti.
sn22.81:4.5: atha kho bhagavā tassa bhikkhuno cetasā cetoparivitakkamaññāya bhikkhū āmantesi:
sn22.81:4.14: evaṃ vicayaso kho desito bhikkhave, mayā dhammo.
sn22.81:4.15: evaṃ vicayaso desite kho bhikkhave, mayā dhamme atha ca panidhekaccassa bhikkhuno evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
sn22.81:4.16: “kathaṃ nu kho jānato kathaṃ passato anantarā āsavānaṃ khayo hotī”ti.
sn22.81:5.1: kathaṃ ca bhikkhave, jānato kathaṃ passato anantarā āsavānaṃ khayo hoti:
sn22.81:5.2: idha bhikkhave, assutavā puthujjano ariyānaṃ adassāvī ariyadhammassa akovido ariyadhamme avinīto, sappurisānaṃ adassāvī sappurisadhammassa akovido sappurisadhamme avinīto,
sn22.81:5.4: yā kho pana sā bhikkhave, samanupassanā saṅkhāro so.
sn22.81:5.5: so pana saṅkhāro kinnidāno kiṃsamudayo kiñjātiko kimpabhavoti:
sn22.81:5.6: avijjāsamphassajena bhikkhave, vedayitena phuṭṭhassa assutavato puthujjanassa uppannā taṇhā
sn22.81:5.8: iti kho bhikkhave, sopi saṅkhāro anicco saṅkhato paṭiccasamuppanno.
sn22.81:5.10: sāpi vedanā aniccā saṅkhatā paṭiccasamuppannā. sopi phasso anicco saṅkhato paṭiccasamuppanno.
sn22.81:5.12: evampi kho bhikkhave, jānato evaṃ passato anantarā āsavānaṃ khayo hoti.
sn22.81:6.1: na heva kho rūpaṃ attato samanupassati
sn22.81:6.2: api ca kho rūpavantaṃ attānaṃ samanupassati.
sn22.81:6.3: yā kho pana sā bhikkhave, samanupassanā saṅkhāro so.
sn22.81:6.4: so pana saṅkhāro kinnidāno kiṃsamudayo kiñjātiko kimpabhavo:
sn22.81:6.5: avijjāsamphassajena bhikkhave, vedayitena phuṭṭhassa assutavato puthujjanassa uppannā taṇhā.
sn22.81:6.7: iti kho bhikkhave, sopi saṅkhāro anicco saṅkhato paṭiccasamuppanno.
sn22.81:6.12: evampi kho bhikkhave, jānato evaṃ passato anantarā āsavānaṃ khayo hoti.

sn22.81:7.2: api ca kho attani rūpaṃ samanupassati.
sn22.81:7.3: yā kho pana sā bhikkhave, samanupassanā saṅkhāro so.

sn22.81:7.7: iti kho bhikkhave, sopi saṅkhāro anicco saṅkhato paṭiccasamuppanno.
sn22.81:7.12: evampi kho bhikkhave, jānato evaṃ passato anantarā āsavānaṃ khayo hoti.
sn22.81:8.1: na heva kho rūpaṃ attato samanupassati, na rūpavantaṃ attānaṃ samanupassati, na attani rūpaṃ samanupassati.
sn22.81:8.2: api ca kho rūpasmiṃ attānaṃ samanupassati.
sn22.81:8.3: yā kho pana sā bhikkhave, samanupassanā saṅkhāro so.
sn22.81:8.4: so pana saṅkhāro kinnidāno kiṃsamudayo kiñjātiko kimpabhavo:
sn22.81:8.5: avijjāsamphassajena bhikkhave, vedayitena phuṭṭhassa assutavato puthujjanassa uppannā taṇhā
sn22.81:8.7: iti kho bhikkhave, sopi saṅkhāro anicco saṅkhato paṭiccasamuppanno.

sn22.81:9.1: na heva kho rūpaṃ attato samanupassati, na rūpavantaṃ attānaṃ samanupassati, na attani rūpaṃ samunupassati, na rūpasmiṃ attānaṃ samanupassati.
sn22.81:9.2: api ca kho vedanaṃ attato samanupassati. …pe… (yathā rūpakkhandhe vitthāro evaṃ upari cattāro khandhā vitthāretabbā.) api ca kho vedanāvantaṃ attānaṃ samanupassati …pe… api ca kho attani vedanaṃ samanupassati …pe… api ca kho vedanāya attānaṃ samanupassati …pe…
sn22.81:9.3: api ca kho saññaṃ attato samanupassati. …pe… api ca kho saññāvantaṃ attānaṃ samanupassati …pe… api ca kho attani saññaṃ samanupassati …pe… api ca kho saññāya attānaṃ samanupassati …pe…
sn22.81:9.4: api ca kho saṅkhāre attato samanupassati …pe… api ca kho saṅkhāravantaṃ attānaṃ samanupassati …pe… api ca kho attani saṅkhāre samanupassati …pe… api ca kho saṅkhāresu attānaṃ samanupassati …pe…
sn22.81:9.5: api ca kho viññāṇaṃ attato samanupassati …pe… api ca kho viññāṇavantaṃ attānaṃ samanupassati …pe… api ca kho attani viññāṇaṃ samanupassati …pe… api ca kho viññāṇasmiṃ attānaṃ samanupassati.
sn22.81:9.6: yā kho pana sā bhikkhave, samanupassanā, saṅkhāro so.
sn22.81:9.7: so pana saṅkhāro kinnidāno kiṃsamudayo kiñjātiko kimpabhavo:
sn22.81:9.8: avijjāsamphassajena bhikkhave, vedayitena phuṭṭhassa assutavato puthujjanassa uppannā taṇhā.
sn22.81:9.10: iti kho bhikkhave, so’pi saṅkhāro anicco saṅkhato paṭiccasamuppanno.
sn22.81:9.15: evampi kho bhikkhave, jānato evaṃ passato anantarā āsavānaṃ khayo hoti.
sn22.81:10.1: na heva kho rūpaṃ attato samanupassati, na rūpavantaṃ attānaṃ samanupassati na attani rūpaṃ samanupassati na rūpasmiṃ attānaṃ samanupassati.
sn22.81:10.2: na vedanaṃ attato samanupassati, na vedanāvantaṃ attānaṃ samanupassati na attani vedanaṃ samanupassati na vedanāya attānaṃ samanupassati.
sn22.81:10.3: na saññaṃ attato samanupassati, na saññāvantaṃ attānaṃ samanupassati. na attani saññaṃ samanupassati. na saññāya attānaṃ samanupassati.
sn22.81:10.4: na saṅkhāre attato samanupassati. na saṅkhāravantaṃ attānaṃ samanupassati. na attani saṅkhāre samanupassati. na saṅkhāresu attānaṃ samanupassati.
sn22.81:10.5: na viññāṇaṃ attato samanupassati. na viññāṇavantaṃ attānaṃ samanupassati. na attani viññāṇaṃ samanupassati. na viññāṇasmiṃ attānaṃ samanupassati.
sn22.81:10.6: api ca kho evaṃ diṭṭhi hoti:
sn22.81:10.7: “so attā so loko so pecca bhavissāmi nicco dhuvo sassato avipariṇāmadhammo”ti.
sn22.81:10.8: yā kho pana sā bhikkhave, sassatadiṭṭhi saṅkhāro so.
sn22.81:10.9: so pana saṅkhāro kinnidāno kiṃsamudayo kiñjātiko kimpabhavo: avijjā samphassajena bhikkhave, vedayitena phuṭṭhassa assutavato puthujjanassa uppannā taṇhā. tatojo so saṅkhāro. iti kho bhikkhave so’pi saṅkhāro anicco saṅkhato paṭiccasamuppanno sāpi taṇhā …pe… sā’pi vedanā …pe… so’pi phasso …pe… sā’pi avijjā aniccā saṅkhatā paṭiccasamuppannā.
sn22.81:10.10: evampi kho bhikkhave, jānato evaṃ passato anantarā āsavānaṃ khayo hoti.
sn22.81:11.1: na heva kho rūpaṃ attato samanupassati,
sn22.81:11.2: na rūpavantaṃ attānaṃ samanupassati na attani rūpaṃ samanupassati na rūpasmiṃ attānaṃ samanupassati. na vedanaṃ …pe…
sn22.81:11.5: na viññāṇaṃ attato samanupassati. na viññāṇavantaṃ attānaṃ samanupassati. na attani viññāṇaṃ samanupassati. na viññāṇasmiṃ attānaṃ samanupassati.
sn22.81:11.7: so attā so loko so pecca bhavissāmi nicco dhuvo sassato avipariṇāmadhammo’ti.
sn22.81:11.8: api ca kho evaṃ diṭṭhi hoti:
sn22.81:11.9: “no cassaṃ no ca me siyā na bhavissāmi’ na me bhavissatī”ti.
sn22.81:11.10: yā kho pana sā bhikkhave, ucchedadiṭṭhi saṅkhāro so.
sn22.81:11.11: so pana saṅkhāro kinnidāno kiṃsamudayo kiñjātiko kimpabhavo:
sn22.81:11.12: avijjāsamphassajena, bhikkhave, vedayitena phuṭṭhassa assutavato puthujjanassa uppannā taṇhā
sn22.81:11.14: iti kho bhikkhave, so’pi saṅkhāro anicco saṅkhato paṭiccasampanno. sāpi taṇhā, sāpi vedanā …pe… sopi phasso …pe… ‘sāpi avijjā aniccā saṅkhatā paṭiccasamuppannā
sn22.81:11.15: evampi kho bhikkhave, jānato evaṃ passato anantarā āsavānaṃ khayo hoti.
sn22.81:12.1: na heva kho rūpaṃ attato samanupassati, na rūpavantaṃ attānaṃ samanupassati na attani rūpaṃ samanupassati na rūpasmiṃ attānaṃ samanupassati. na vedanaṃ attato samanupassati, na vedanāvantaṃ attānaṃ samanupassati na attani vedanaṃ samanupassati na vedanāya attānaṃ samanupassati.
sn22.81:12.2: na saññaṃ attato samanupassati, na saññāvantaṃ attānaṃ samanupassati. na attani saññaṃ samanupassati. na saññāya attānaṃ samanupassati.
sn22.81:12.3: na saṅkhāre attato samanupassati. na saṅkhāravantaṃ attānaṃ samanupassati. na attani saṅkhāre samanupassati. na saṅkhāresu attānaṃ samanupassati.
sn22.81:12.4: na viññāṇaṃ attato samanupassati. na viññāṇavantaṃ attānaṃ samanupassati. na attani viññāṇaṃ samanupassati.
sn22.81:12.5: na viññāṇasmiṃ attānaṃ samanupassati. nā’pi evaṃ diṭṭhi hoti.
sn22.81:12.6: ‘so attā so loko, so pecca bhavissāmi nicco dhuvo sassato avipariṇāmadhammoti.
sn22.81:12.8: “no cassaṃ no ca me siyā na bhavissāmi na me bhavissatī”ti.
sn22.81:12.9: api ca kho “kaṅkhī hoti vecikicchī aniṭṭhaṅgato saddhamme”.
sn22.81:12.10: yā kho pana sā bhikkhave, kaṅkhitā vecikicchitā aniṭṭhaṅgatatā saddhamme, saṅkhāro so.
sn22.81:12.11: so pana saṅkhāro kinnidāno kiṃsamudayo kiñjātiko kimpabhavo:
sn22.81:12.12: avijjāsamphassajena bhikkhave, vedayitena phuṭṭhassa assutavato puthujjanassa uppannā taṇhā,
sn22.81:12.14: iti kho bhikkhave, so’pi saṅkhāro anicco saṅkhato paṭiccasamuppanno.
sn22.81:12.19: evaṃ pi kho bhikkhave, jānato evaṃ passato anantarā āsavānaṃ khayo hotīti.
